# FAITH
T_kCAFG_does_province_contain_faith = {
	has_variable_list = kCAFG_province_faiths
    is_target_in_variable_list = {
        name = kCAFG_province_faiths
        target = $FAITH$
    }
}

T_kCAFG_does_province_contain_any_faith = {
	has_variable_list = kCAFG_province_faiths
    variable_list_size = {
        name = kCAFG_province_faiths
        value > 0
    }
}

# VALUE
T_kCAFG_province_faiths_count_at_least = {
	has_variable_list = kCAFG_province_faiths
    variable_list_size = {
        name = kCAFG_province_faiths
        value >= $VALUE$
    }
}

# Only faith in province
# FAITH
T_kCAFG_province_only_faith = {
    variable_list_size = {
        name = kCAFG_province_faiths
        value = 1
    }
    is_target_in_variable_list = {
        name = kCAFG_province_faiths
        target = $FAITH$
    }
}
